decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's existing market-data and analytics knowledge, and after surviving another year it looks like a product the firm can continue to refine and commercialize effectively through its own R&D.

The regional electricity tariff calculator remains very close to the firm's core calculation, billing and utility-process competences, so absorptive capacity is high and continued improvement is relatively low risk.
The area definition tool complements the central platform and the firm's data-process capabilities, making it a strategically fitting product that the firm is well placed to improve further.

Although it still appears less prominent than the other retained products, it is close enough to the firm's tariff-comparison know-how that customer learning and in-house development can justify keeping it on the market.
